  - text: CLASS 10 · CIRCLE PROOFS
  - heading "Tangent Lengths from an External Point" [level=1]
  - paragraph: From an external point P, the lengths of the tangent segments PA and PB to a circle are equal.
  - text: 30 min RIGOROUS PROOF geometry2d
  - navigation:
    - button "Interact"
    - button "Learn"
    - button "Example"
    - button "Formula"
    - button "Practice"
  - main:
    - heading "Explore the Theorem" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag point P or the tangent points A and B. Watch how PA and PB always stay equal.
    - complementary:
      - heading "Controls" [level=3]
      - text: Drag P (external point)
      - checkbox "Drag P (external point)" [checked]
      - text: Drag A (tangent point)
      - checkbox "Drag A (tangent point)" [checked]
      - text: Drag B (tangent point)
      - checkbox "Drag B (tangent point)" [checked]
      - heading "Show / Hide" [level=3]
      - checkbox "Radii OA, OB" [checked]
      - text: Radii OA, OB
      - checkbox "Right-angle marks" [checked]
      - text: Right-angle marks
      - checkbox "Congruent triangles ΔOAP & ΔOBP" [checked]
      - text: Congruent triangles ΔOAP & ΔOBP
      - button "Reset construction"
    - article:
      - img "Two tangent segments from external point P":
        - text: Chord Tangent Angle O
        - slider "Point A"
        - text: A
        - slider "Point B"
        - text: B
        - slider "Point P"
        - text: P PA = 8.00 cm PB = 8.00 cm
    - img
    - text: Result
    - strong: PA = PB
    - text: The tangent segments from P are equal.
    - paragraph: PA 8.00 cm
    - paragraph: PB 8.00 cm
    - paragraph: Difference 0.00 cm
    - article:
      - heading "Why It Works" [level=2]
      - paragraph: ΔOAP and ΔOBP are right triangles.
      - list:
        - listitem: OA = OB = radius
        - listitem: ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°
        - listitem: OP = OP (common side)
      - paragraph: By RHS (HL) congruence,
      - strong: ΔOAP ≅ ΔOBP
      - paragraph: Therefore, PA = PB.
    - article:
      - heading "Worked Example" [level=2]
      - paragraph: If PA = 8 cm, then PB = 8 cm.
      - text: O A B
      - strong: P
      - paragraph: PA = 8 cm PB = 8 cm
    - article:
      - heading "Common Misconception" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Common Misconception
      - paragraph: It is not true that tangent lengths from different external points are equal.
      - paragraph: The equality holds only for tangent segments from the same external point.
      - text: P Q O
      - paragraph: In general, PA ≠ QA.
    - article:
      - heading "Your Challenge" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Your Challenge
      - paragraph: Drag point P to different locations. Observe how PA and PB change, but always remain equal.
      - text: "Try this:"
      - paragraph: Move P far away and then closer to the circle. What do you notice about the lengths?
      - img
      - text: Challenge Goal
      - paragraph: Keep exploring until you see PA = PB at every position of P.
